months.name: January
months.text: The duke at table, his household and guests exchanging New Year's gifts; a tapestry of battle behind them.

months.name: February
months.text: Winter at a farm: peasants warm themselves by the fire, a woman blows on her hands, snow on the hives and the hills.

months.name: March
months.text: Ploughing, pruning the vines and sowing under the castle of Lusignan; the fairy Melusine flies over its tower.

months.name: April
months.text: A betrothal: young nobles exchange rings in a garden, the castle of Dourdan beyond.

months.name: May
months.text: The May-day ride: courtiers in green ride out with trumpets, the Paris of the Palais de la Cité behind them.

months.name: June
months.text: Haymaking on the left bank of the Seine, facing the Palais de la Cité and the Sainte-Chapelle in Paris.

months.name: July
months.text: Reaping the wheat and shearing the sheep below the castle of Poitiers.

months.name: August
months.text: Falconry: a hunting party rides out while peasants bathe in the river, the castle of Étampes above.

months.name: September
months.text: The grape harvest under the castle of Saumur, its towers and gilded weathervanes.

months.name: October
months.text: Sowing the winter wheat, a scarecrow and nets against the birds, the Louvre of Charles V across the Seine.

months.name: November
months.text: A swineherd knocks down acorns for his pigs at the edge of the forest.

months.name: December
months.text: The boar hunt in the forest of Vincennes, the hounds on the boar, the castle's keep above the trees.
